dynamics_parameter_sources.shared_lineage: The SO101 README, joints_properties.xml, scene.xml, old-calibration XML, and assets have identical Git objects in both repositories; the second repository is inherited evidence, not an independent calibration validation.
dynamics_parameter_sources.selection_rationale: Both current new-calibration XML files agree on the effective joint and actuator values. The separately copied joints_properties.xml predates the actuator-model update and retains stale kp=17.8 and kv=0 values, so it is not used. Geometry, cameras, sites, joint ranges, and ctrlrange remain package-owned and unchanged.
